articles.title: EU hits Russia with massive 21st sanctions package targeting $120B crypto network
articles.snippet: The EU is considering a ban on third-country crypto services providers for the first time and is targeting 14 crypto companies, which it has not named yet.

articles.title: Poolin was bitcoin's biggest mining pool and now it's filing for bankruptcy
articles.snippet: The Singapore-based company once controlled nearly a fifth of Bitcoin's global hashrate. Now it owes $173 million and is selling off what's left.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury companies sell up, repay debt, pivot to AI as share prices collapse
articles.snippet: Falling share prices, debt obligations and difficult market conditions are forcing former bitcoin accumulators to sell their holdings and restructure operations.

articles.title: BitMEX faces proposed class-action suit for theft, insider trading as crypto exchange shuts down
articles.snippet: The complaint claims BitMEX designed a system to retain customer collateral and alleges an internal desk accessed private user data during server freezes.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin gives up gains, falls below $64,000 as stocks retreat
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor's Strategy — under continued pressure in this crypto bear market — released a new set of metrics to judge company performance.
